'''Marl Semtin''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], he was in command of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Harrow/Legends|''Harrow'']]. [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] dispatched him to recover the stockhouse of [[Eidolon Base]] for him on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], offering Semtin a percentage of its armaments in return. This assignment brought him into conflict with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. As the Rogues and their allies [[Tatooine Campaign|attacked]] the base, Semtin tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Firith Olan]] but was intercepted by [[Sixtus Quin]]. Quin killed him while he was trying to escape, the Imperial Agent having become disillusioned with his commander after being left behind during a mission to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].
